definitions.explanation: A flat-bodied fish that lies on the ocean floor with both eyes on one side. Prized in Japanese cuisine for its delicate white flesh, especially as sashimi and sushi.

examples.japanese: ヒラメ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
ヒラメ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧な⟦{白身魚|しろみざかな}→白身魚：21114_shiromizakana⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Flounder is known as a high-quality white fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ヒラメ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}したら→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧⟦{絶品|ぜっぴん}→絶品：13811_zeppin⟧だった。
examples.english: When I ordered the flounder fin edge at the sushi restaurant, it was exquisite.

notes:
USAGE:
A prized sushi and sashimi fish. ヒラメ is particularly valued for its ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧ (the fin edge), which has a distinctive crunchy texture.

ヒラメ VS. カレイ:
Both are flatfish, but they are different species. The saying 「⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧ヒラメ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧カレイ」 (flounder on the left, sole on the right) helps distinguish them: when the belly faces you, ヒラメ has its eyes on the left side and カレイ on the right.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヒラメ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧ (flounder sashimi)
- ヒラメ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧ (simmered flounder)
- ヒラメ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧ (flounder fin edge — a delicacy)
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ヒラメ (wild-caught flounder)

WRITING:
Usually written in katakana. The kanji {鮃|ひらめ} exists but is rare outside specialized contexts.
